title: DeepSeek-V4: Towards Highly Efficient Million-Token Context Intelligence
supported_claims: V4 combines CSA/HCA, mHC, MoE and MTP; Pro has 1.6T total parameters and pretraining uses more than 32T tokens.
limitations: Version identifier and displayed April 26 date disagree; preserve both. No tiny-data controlled result.
voynich_implication: Defer compressed caches until profiling demonstrates a local need.

title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression
supported_claims: Uses causal encoder-decoder, CSA2 cache sharing and Engram; omits backbone-pretraining MTP.
limitations: Many simultaneous architecture/data changes; deployment savings do not isolate small-corpus scientific utility.
voynich_implication: Do not import the entire frontier architecture; use separately testable mechanisms.

title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
supported_claims: Reports 671B-total/37B-active MoE, MLA and MTP, trained on 14.8T tokens.
limitations: No new section-level re-read here; architectural details inherited from earlier project review must not be counted as new reading.
voynich_implication: Reference lineage for MLA/MTP; defer cache compression.

title: DeepSeek-V3.2: Pushing the Frontier of Open Large Language Models
supported_claims: Reports DSA for efficient long-context attention and substantial post-training changes.
limitations: Abstract cannot isolate architectural contributions from training changes.
voynich_implication: Use as versioned sparse-attention lead, not evidence for tiny-data superiority.

title: mHC: Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections
supported_claims: Constrains expanded residual-stream mixing through doubly stochastic matrices to improve propagation stability.
limitations: Mixing is not a literal identity map; reported overhead depends on custom large-scale infrastructure.
voynich_implication: Defer until shallow-model instability exists; stream mixing increases intervention complexity.

title: Conditional Memory via Scalable Lookup: A New Axis of Sparsity for Large Language Models
supported_claims: Engram retrieves hashed suffix n-gram embeddings and gates their contribution using contextual state.
limitations: Large MoE experiments; mechanistic similarity metrics do not establish a unique causal explanation.
voynich_implication: A small lookup branch is a candidate only against matched n-gram controls and fresh-key transfer.

title: Qwen3.5-0.8B model card
supported_claims: The dense 0.8B model uses six groups of three Gated DeltaNet blocks and one gated-attention block; the card lists multi-step MTP.
limitations: Mutable model card; no isolated ablation proving the hybrid ratio is best at Voynich scale. Family MoE marketing does not describe every size.
voynich_implication: Validate current hybrid lineage, then compare a small independently instrumented recurrence.

title: Gated Delta Networks: Improving Mamba2 with Delta Rule
sections_read: 3.1 and 3.4 gated delta rule and hybrid models
supported_claims: Combines targeted delta-rule writes with scalar decay; 1.3B-model/100B-token comparisons include recurrent and attention hybrids.
limitations: Fixed-state memory still limits retrieval; billion-scale results do not predict tiny-model ranking.
voynich_implication: Ablate gate, signed update and short-attention branch separately.

title: Kimi Linear: An Expressive, Efficient Attention Architecture
supported_claims: KDA uses coordinate-specific decay; a 3:1 recurrent/MLA hybrid is tested. Two-layer synthetic tasks include copying, recall and stacks.
limitations: Synthetic curves select best training accuracy after LR search; 48B-total/3B-active frontier configuration is far larger.
voynich_implication: Promising recurrence control; use development selection and untouched transfer tests.

title: Mamba-3: Improved Sequence Modeling using State Space Principles
supported_claims: Mamba-3 adds complex transitions, richer discretization and MIMO. Matched 100B-token language experiments span 180M to 1.5B parameters.
limitations: Transformer retrieval remains stronger; model-scale gains and CUDA kernels do not imply MPS speed or hidden-rule identification.
voynich_implication: Consider transition components as separate controls after an inspectable recurrence reference.

title: The Illusion of State in State-Space Models
supported_claims: Bounded-depth diagonal or non-gated SSM classes have restricted state-tracking expressivity under specified arithmetic assumptions.
limitations: Complexity separation uses a standard conjecture; does not cover arbitrary nonlinear RNNs or all newer transitions.
voynich_implication: Specify the exact transition class before claiming a recurrent model can represent our synthetic rules.

title: DeltaProduct: Improving State-Tracking in Linear RNNs via Householder Products
supported_claims: Multiple distinct Householder updates enlarge transition expressivity; formal-language tests train at lengths 3-40 and test through 256.
limitations: Known task supervision differs from ciphertext-only recovery; runtime measured on Nvidia L40, not Mac.
voynich_implication: Test one versus two/four signed transition factors with equal-budget controls.

title: Learning to (Learn at Test Time): RNNs with Expressive Hidden States
supported_claims: TTT uses trainable fast-state weights and an inner reconstruction objective; mini-batching trades sequential updates for parallelization.
limitations: 125M-1.3B language experiments; no proof fast weights recover a cipher or retain uniquely interpretable state.
voynich_implication: Candidate for prefix-only adaptation with complete fast-state reset and intervention replay.

title: Titans: Learning to Memorize at Test Time
sections_read: 3 neural long-term memory: objective, momentum and forgetting
supported_claims: Titans combines an inner associative-memory objective with momentum-like updates and adaptive forgetting.
limitations: Broad benchmark gains do not identify a historical mechanism; complete method/evaluation not re-read.
voynich_implication: Defer deep memory until simpler online estimators and TTT-Linear establish a transfer benefit.

title: Nested Learning: The Illusion of Deep Learning Architectures
supported_claims: Proposes nested optimization timescales, continuum memory and the Hope module.
limitations: Abstract-only: no independently checked theorem, implementation or benchmark claim is used.
voynich_implication: Conceptual lead for later review, not an accepted architecture.

title: Byte Latent Transformer: Patches Scale Better Than Tokens
supported_claims: BLT uses causal entropy-guided patches and local byte modules; studies up to 8B parameters and 4T bytes.
limitations: 2024 version header coexists with a 2026 rendered footer; learned patches are not historical linguistic units.
voynich_implication: Compare reversible segmentations on identical underlying symbols, with causal-prefix checks.

title: Dynamic Chunking for End-to-End Hierarchical Sequence Modeling
supported_claims: H-Net learns chunk routing and causal smoothing within a hierarchical model; language-model comparisons use large byte corpora.
limitations: Hundreds of millions to billions of parameters; qualitative boundaries do not prove semantic or glyph identity.
voynich_implication: Later segmentation ablation with fixed/random controls and original-position alignment.

title: Better & Faster Large Language Models via Multi-token Prediction
sections_read: Prior project review of section 4.1 and Appendix J; current page reopened
supported_claims: Multi-token training shares a trunk across future predictions and reports data-efficiency gains in tested settings.
limitations: Independent marginals are not joint future predictions; current re-read initially limited, prior notes identify test-selected checkpoints.
voynich_implication: Require joint-future diagnostics rather than claiming MTP solved hidden dynamics.

title: Reasoning with Latent Thoughts: On the Power of Looped Transformers
supported_claims: Studies expressive and empirical effects of repeated parameter-shared transformer layers.
limitations: Extra compute is not extra independent data or guaranteed algorithm learning.
voynich_implication: Later matched-parameter and matched-compute loop ablation with per-iteration hooks.

title: Scaling Data-Constrained Language Models
supported_claims: Data repetition has diminishing returns under tested recipes; study spans up to 9B parameters and 900B training tokens.
limitations: No universal epoch cutoff and no numerical scaling extrapolation to the manuscript.
voynich_implication: Track unique data separately from sampled training exposure.

title: Muon is Scalable for LLM Training
supported_claims: Muon scaling work adds weight decay and update-scale adjustments; releases a large MoE trained with the optimizer.
limitations: Compute-optimal frontier improvements are not a local throughput estimate.
voynich_implication: Isolated optimizer comparison preserves the causal model graph.

title: Unlocking State-Tracking in Linear RNNs Through Negative Eigenvalues
supported_claims: Signed eigenvalues and products of transition factors support stronger finite-state constructions than positive-only restrictions.
limitations: The broad regular-language construction can require exponential depth; representability is not learnability.
voynich_implication: Include signed-transition and nonlinear recurrent controls, not just positive forgetting gates.

title: Data-Constrained Language Model Pretraining: Improved Regularization and Scaling Laws
supported_claims: MIR adds a masked-input next-token auxiliary loss to tuned strong-weight-decay AR models; tested at 72M-1.4B and 100M unique tokens.
limitations: Extra compute; much larger corpus; AR/diffusion estimators and checkpoint selection differ; toy theory does not prove cipher benefits.
voynich_implication: Prioritize a small regularization factorial with clean held-out scoring and synthetic recovery diagnostics.

title: Learning State-Tracking from Code Using Linear RNNs
sections_read: 5 partial observability and PFSA-SR belief update
supported_claims: Distinguishes deterministic visible transitions from uncertain transitions requiring belief conditioning and renormalization.
limitations: Code traces and state reveals are stronger structure than manuscript ciphertext; full results not yet audited.
voynich_implication: Keep ambiguous-state controls; compare explicit belief updates with linear and nonlinear recurrent models.

title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models: Non-linearity, Sparsity, and Attention-Sink-Free
sections_read: Bibliographic record; abstract-level lead retained from prior architecture review
supported_claims: Studies sigmoid attention-output gating and alternative placements.
limitations: No new methods-level reading this turn; no claim that a low gate identifies filler.
voynich_implication: Existing isolated gate switch remains preferable to combining untested changes.

title: When Data Is Scarce: Scaling Sparse Language Models with Repeated Training
supported_claims: Studies sparse repeated-data training across explicit unique-data, sparsity and epoch budgets.
limitations: Abstract-only; sparse parameter training is not automatically MoE; studied data budgets dwarf Voynich.
voynich_implication: Defer until methods and sparse-implementation costs are reviewed.
